content: मर्दन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [मृद्-ल्यु ल्युट् वा] Crushing, grinding, destroying, tormenting, rubbing, <ab>&c.</ab>; सलक्ष्मणं राघवमाजिमर्दनम् <ls>Rām. 5. 37. 67</ls>. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Crushing, grinding. .²2 Rubbing, shampooing; मदर्नं गुणवर्धनम्. .²3 Anointing (with unguents <ab>&c.</ab>). .²4 Pressing, kneading. .²5 Paining, tormenting, afflicting. .²6 Destroying. .²7 Devastating, laying waste. .²8 Opposition of planets. .²9 Breaking up (as of ice <ab>&c.</ab>).
